// ranking_medium: written by gen_arith_dice.py from ranking_medium.jl, the
// Alea.jl form of experiments/dicejl/ranking_medium.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl, branch arithmetic,
// commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5 (Apache License 2.0).
// Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: ranking-medium.
//
// The integers are 6 bits, signed in two's complement: lt(x, y) is
// x < y of signed integers, and the original's uniform(-4, 5) is
// uniform(0, 9) minus 4. Each ranking draws a noisy rank of every
// item, o<k>_<i> for ranking k and item i, and observes their order.
fun lt(x: int(6), y: int(6)) { x + int(6, 32) < y + int(6, 32) }
let r1 = uniform(6, 0, 4) in
let r2 = uniform(6, 0, 4) in
let r3 = uniform(6, 0, 4) in
let r4 = uniform(6, 0, 4) in
let distinct1_2 = observe r1 != r2 in
let distinct1_3 = observe r1 != r3 in
let distinct1_4 = observe r1 != r4 in
let distinct2_3 = observe r2 != r3 in
let distinct2_4 = observe r2 != r4 in
let distinct3_4 = observe r3 != r4 in
let o1_1 = r1 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o1_2 = r2 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o1_3 = r3 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o1_4 = r4 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let seen1_1 = observe lt(o1_4, o1_3) in
let seen1_2 = observe lt(o1_3, o1_2) in
let seen1_3 = observe lt(o1_2, o1_1) in
let o2_1 = r1 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o2_2 = r2 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o2_3 = r3 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o2_4 = r4 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let seen2_1 = observe lt(o2_2, o2_4) in
let seen2_2 = observe lt(o2_4, o2_3) in
let seen2_3 = observe lt(o2_3, o2_1) in
let o3_1 = r1 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o3_2 = r2 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o3_3 = r3 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let o3_4 = r4 + (uniform(6, 0, 9) - int(6, 4)) in
let seen3_1 = observe lt(o3_2, o3_3) in
let seen3_2 = observe lt(o3_3, o3_4) in
let seen3_3 = observe lt(o3_4, o3_1) in
(r1, (r2, (r3, r4)))

#lang roulette/example/disrupt
;; ranking_medium.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))
;; (Not cond's `=>`: the language binds `=>` to Rosette's implication.)
(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))
(define (report-bool k dist)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #f))))
(define (report-int k dist w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([vp (in-list dist)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural (car vp)) (cdr vp)))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))

(define (f-lt x1-x x2-y)
  (define x3-lt (bv-ult (bv-add x1-x '(#f #f #f #f #f #t)) (bv-add x2-y '(#f #f #f #f #f #t))))
  x3-lt)

(define clock (start-clock))
(define x4-r1 (uniform 6 0 4))
(define x5-r2 (uniform 6 0 4))
(define x6-r3 (uniform 6 0 4))
(define x7-r4 (uniform 6 0 4))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x4-r1 x5-r2))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x4-r1 x6-r3))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x4-r1 x7-r4))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x5-r2 x6-r3))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x5-r2 x7-r4))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x6-r3 x7-r4))))
(define x8-o1-1 (uniform 6 0 9))
(define x9-o1-1 (bv-add x4-r1 (bv-sub x8-o1-1 '(#f #f #t #f #f #f))))
(define x10-o1-2 (uniform 6 0 9))
(define x11-o1-2 (bv-add x5-r2 (bv-sub x10-o1-2 '(#f #f #t #f #f #f))))
(define x12-o1-3 (uniform 6 0 9))
(define x13-o1-3 (bv-add x6-r3 (bv-sub x12-o1-3 '(#f #f #t #f #f #f))))
(define x14-o1-4 (uniform 6 0 9))
(define x15-o1-4 (bv-add x7-r4 (bv-sub x14-o1-4 '(#f #f #t #f #f #f))))
(define x16-seen1-1 (f-lt x15-o1-4 x13-o1-3))
(statement (observe! x16-seen1-1))
(define x17-seen1-2 (f-lt x13-o1-3 x11-o1-2))
(statement (observe! x17-seen1-2))
(define x18-seen1-3 (f-lt x11-o1-2 x9-o1-1))
(statement (observe! x18-seen1-3))
(define x19-o2-1 (uniform 6 0 9))
(define x20-o2-1 (bv-add x4-r1 (bv-sub x19-o2-1 '(#f #f #t #f #f #f))))

# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: ranking-medium.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    uniq_count = 4
    bits = Int(floor(log2(uniq_count)) + 4)

    rankings = [[3, 2, 1, 0],
                [1, 3, 2, 0],
                [1, 2, 3, 0]]

    ranks = [uniform(DistInt{bits}, 0, uniq_count) for i in 1:uniq_count]
    for i in 1:uniq_count
        for j in i+1:uniq_count
            observe(!prob_equals(ranks[i], ranks[j]))
        end
    end


    for data in rankings
        obs_rank = [x + uniform(DistInt{bits}, -uniq_count, uniq_count+1) for x in ranks]
        for i in 1:uniq_count-1
            a, b = data[i]+1, data[i+1] + 1
            observe(obs_rank[a] < obs_rank[b])
        end
    end

    (ranks[1], ranks[2], ranks[3], ranks[4])
end

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)

(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))

  (if e (cdr e) 0))

# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: ranking-small.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    uniq_count = 4
    bits = Int(floor(log2(uniq_count)) + 4)

    rankings = [[3, 2, 1, 0]]

    ranks = [uniform(DistInt{bits}, 0, uniq_count) for i in 1:uniq_count]
    for i in 1:uniq_count
        for j in i+1:uniq_count
            observe(!prob_equals(ranks[i], ranks[j]))
        end
    end


    for data in rankings
        obs_rank = [x + uniform(DistInt{bits}, -uniq_count, uniq_count+1) for x in ranks]
        for i in 1:uniq_count-1
            a, b = data[i]+1, data[i+1] + 1
            observe(obs_rank[a] < obs_rank[b])
        end
    end

    (ranks[1], ranks[2], ranks[3], ranks[4])
end
